• Tugboat Targeting & Salvage Escalation: Alongside an IMO advisory urging vessels to avoid the Strait of Hormuz outright and reiterated warnings from the Swedish Club against non-essential passages, Iran's Persian Gulf Strait Authority expanded its sanctioned target registry to include 26 tugboats and offshore support vessels (Hellenic Shipping News). • Fujairah Waits & Saudi OSP Adjustments: Ship-to-ship (STS) transfers in the Gulf of Oman and loadings at Fujairah continue to sustain regional export flows, with Signal Ocean data showing Fujairah loading wait times improving from a median of 190 hours in September to 138 hours in November. • BIMCO Seaborne Volume Contraction & Segment Divergence: According to BIMCO Chief Shipping Analyst Niels Rasmussen in Hellenic Shipping News, cumulative 2026 seaborne crude and dirty-product volumes are down 5% year-on-year while clean-product volumes have fallen 11% year-on-year, driven by Strait of Hormuz disruptions, the Houthi blockade of Saudi Red Sea exports, and attacks on Russian refineries and Black Sea vessels (where Russian clean-product exports have averaged 58% below 2025 levels since Q3).
